values: Root for XBRL GL. No entry made here.
Parent for entry headers/journal entry headers.
Date this entry was posted (validated) to the general ledger. May not represent the date of accounting significance which is represented by 'postingDate'.
One of the following enumerated list: adjusting, budget, comparative, external-accountant, standard, passed-adjusting, eliminating, proposed, recurring, reclassifying, simulated, tax, other
Represents the actual date/time of entry into computer (automated from system date, often misrepresented by changing system clock). Posting dates are maintained separately.
Origin of entry: accrual, manual entry, imported entry, exchange gain or loss
Identifier for a particular entry detail
Description of this line of detail only

Class to provide additional information related to home currencies that differ from original currencies and related exchange rates - typically this will be used to record exchange rates and amounts in currencies and/or on dates other than those of the original transaction. This class allows recording of exchange rates using a third currency as a triangulation currency. This is often EUR but is not restricted to being so. This class may be repeated as many times as necessary to record amounts in foreign currencies on the same or different dates.
Identification for customer, vendor, or employee.

Class for holding job related information, separate from jobs represented in account identifier. Would probably only have one jobinfo class for each entry line, but there may be a need to express more than one.
